index.name: antibiotics
index.purpose: Chemical, pharmacological and mechanistic details for antibacterial agents used in AMR analytics and clinical-isolate annotation.

index.name: bioset
index.purpose: Represents a contrast or set of statistically significant entities (genes, proteins, metabolites, etc.) derived from an experiment — typically a differential-expression list or time-point cluster.

index.name: bioset_result
index.purpose: Stores per-entity quantitative results (counts, log2 FC, p-values, z-scores…) that belong to a bioset so BV-BRC can render volcano plots, heat maps and enrichment tables.

index.name: enzyme_class_ref
index.purpose: Provides the authoritative mapping between EC numbers, their official textual descriptions, and corresponding GO terms, enabling enzyme look-ups and pathway annotation.

index.name: epitope
index.purpose: Captures experimentally verified immune epitopes mapped to BV-BRC proteins, including sequence, host context, assay counts and taxonomy.

index.name: epitope_assay
index.purpose: Holds detailed experimental assay records (B-cell, T-cell, MHC binding, etc.) linked to epitopes, with measurement values, host data and literature citations.

index.name: experiment
index.purpose: High-level metadata for functional-omics experiments (transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, etc.), linking them to biosets, genomes, treatments and publications.

index.name: feature_sequence
index.purpose: Canonical raw sequence for every unique gene, RNA or protein encoded in BV-BRC genomes, keyed by MD5 for rapid identity checks and deduplication.

index.name: gene_ontology_ref
index.purpose: Maps GO identifiers to names, definitions and ontology namespaces so BV-BRC can annotate features and run GO-term enrichment.

index.name: genome
index.purpose: Rich sample, assembly and annotation metadata for every genome in BV-BRC, powering search, filters and downstream analyses across ∼1 M assemblies.

index.name: genome_amr
index.purpose: Antimicrobial-resistance phenotype and/or genotype evidence linked to each genome, including lab methods, computational predictions and literature support.

index.name: genome_feature
index.purpose: All annotated features—coding genes, RNAs, repeats—across BV-BRC genomes, with coordinates, functional annotation and family membership.

index.name: genome_sequence
index.purpose: Every nucleotide replicon (chromosome, plasmid, contig, viral segment, etc.) associated with a genome, with sequence, quality metrics and ACL information.

index.name: id_ref
index.purpose: Cross-walk table linking BV-BRC features to external identifier systems (NCBI GeneID, Ensembl, Pfam, etc.) for inter-database annotation and search.

index.name: misc_niaid_sgc
index.purpose: Tracks gene/protein targets selected by the NIAID Structural Genomics Centers, indicating clone/protein availability and project status.

index.name: pathway
index.purpose: Maps enzyme-encoding features in a genome to Pathway Tools / MetaCyc pathways, enabling metabolic reconstructions and presence/absence matrices.

index.name: pathway_ref
index.purpose: Master lookup linking each EC activity to its position on curated pathway diagrams plus global occurrence counts for enrichment statistics.

index.name: ppi
index.purpose: Pairwise protein–protein interaction metadata (detection methods, scores, literature) for network visualisation and comparative interactomics.

index.name: protein_feature
index.purpose: Domain, motif, signal-peptide and other protein-level annotations identified in CDS translations, with coordinates and statistical scores.

index.name: protein_family_ref
index.purpose: Lookup for every PATRIC protein-family accession (PGFam / PLFam) with descriptive name and namespace.

index.name: protein_structure
index.purpose: Metadata and file pointers for every PDB entry mapped to BV-BRC genomes, including experimental details and chain-to-gene mappings.

index.name: sequence_feature
index.purpose: Per-genome sequence features such as SNPs, indels or peptide motifs, linking them to canonical definitions, evidence codes and literature.

index.name: sequence_feature_vt
index.purpose: Tracks each specific variant form of a canonical sequence feature across genomes, recording prevalence and variant sequences.

index.name: serology
index.purpose: Laboratory serology results linked to host metadata and matching viral genomes, enabling antibody-prevalence and vaccine-impact studies.

index.name: sp_gene
index.purpose: Lists antimicrobial-resistance, virulence and other “specialty” genes detected in genomes, with evidence metrics and curated classifications.

index.name: sp_gene_ref
index.purpose: Master reference catalogue of specialty-gene alleles (AMR, virulence, toxins) with drug associations and literature support.

index.name: spike_lineage
index.purpose: Month-by-month statistics for SARS-CoV-2 Pango lineages (growth, prevalence, VOC status) and their defining spike mutations.

index.name: spike_variant
index.purpose: Monthly global statistics for notable SARS-CoV-2 spike-protein variants (D614G, etc.) including prevalence, growth rate and lineage diversity.

index.name: strain
index.purpose: Per-strain metadata for segmented viruses (esp. influenza), linking segment accessions, host/geographic info and genome records.

index.name: structured_assertion
index.purpose: Machine-readable statements about genomic features (e.g. “gene confers ciprofloxacin resistance”) with evidence codes and citations.

index.name: subsystem
index.purpose: Links individual genes in a genome to SEED subsystems and roles, enabling subsystem heat-maps and completeness metrics.

index.name: subsystem_ref
index.purpose: Reference hierarchy for SEED subsystems, including descriptions, literature and role lists.

index.name: surveillance
index.purpose: Rich epidemiological, clinical and environmental metadata linking genomes to patient or wildlife surveillance information.

index.name: taxonomy
index.purpose: NCBI lineage metadata plus genome-derived statistics (genome count, GC content, etc.) for every taxonomic node represented in BV-BRC.

antibiotics.purpose: Chemical, pharmacological and mechanistic details for antibacterial agents used in AMR analytics and clinical isolate annotation.

taxonomy.purpose: Stores NCBI lineage metadata plus genome-derived statistics (CDS counts, genome sizes, pan-genome metrics) for every taxonomic node represented in BV-BRC.

fields.name: cds_mean
fields.definition: Mean number of CDS per genome

genome.purpose: Stores rich sample, assembly and annotation metadata for every genome record in BV-BRC, enabling search, comparative analysis and QC filtering across ∼1 M bacterial, viral and archaeal assemblies.

strain.purpose: Captures per-strain metadata for segmented viruses (esp. influenza), linking segment accessions, host & geographic info, and associated BV-BRC genome records for downstream comparative and surveillance analyses.

genome_sequence.purpose: Stores every nucleotide replicon (chromosome, plasmid, contig, viral segment, etc.) associated with a BV-BRC genome, linking raw sequence, metadata, quality metrics and access-control information.

genome_feature.purpose: Holds every annotated feature—coding genes, RNAs, repeats—across all BV-BRC genomes, linking sequence coordinates, functional annotation, protein-family membership and external cross-references.

feature_sequence.purpose: Stores the canonical raw sequence for every unique gene, RNA, or protein encoded in BV-BRC genomes, keyed by MD5 for lightning-fast identity checks, duplicate collapse, and cross-genome feature joins.

genome_amr.purpose: Captures antimicrobial-resistance phenotype and/or genotype evidence linked to each BV-BRC genome, including lab methods, computational predictions, standards and literature references.

fields.name: computational_method
fields.definition: Name of the in-silico prediction tool

pathway.purpose: Maps every enzyme-encoding feature in a BV-BRC genome to its KEGG pathway step, enabling genome-scale metabolic reconstructions, comparative pathway presence/absence matrices, and interactive pathway diagrams.

pathway_ref.purpose: Acts as the master lookup table that links each Enzyme Commission activity (ec_number) to its position(s) on curated pathway diagrams (pathway_id, map_location) and records how frequently that EC–pathway pair occurs across BV-BRC genomes, supporting interactive metabolic viewers and pathway-enrichment statistics.

subsystem.purpose: Links individual genes in a BV-BRC genome to SEED subsystems and their roles, enabling subsystem heat-maps, completeness metrics, and metabolic context for comparative genomics.

subsystem_ref.purpose: Master reference for SEED/BV-BRC subsystems, recording each subsystem’s hierarchical category, descriptive text, supporting literature, and the list of functional roles that comprise it. Drives subsystem heat-maps, completeness metrics, and role-based comparative analyses.

sp_gene.purpose: Lists antimicrobial-resistance, virulence, and other “specialty” genes detected in BV-BRC genomes, linking each locus to external curated databases, literature support, and in-silico evidence metrics.

sp_gene_ref.purpose: Serves as the master reference catalog of “specialty” genes (AMR, virulence, toxins, etc.) used to annotate BV-BRC genomes. Each row defines a canonical allele, its function, drug associations, literature support, and provenance.

protein_feature.purpose: Stores every domain, motif, signal peptide, or other protein-level annotation identified in BV-BRC CDS translations, with coordinates, statistical scores, and links to external domain databases.

fields.name: aa_sequence_md5
fields.definition: MD5 hash of the full protein sequence

protein_structure.purpose: Stores metadata and file pointers for every Protein Data Bank entry mapped to BV-BRC genomes, including experimental details, chain-to-gene mappings, lineage, literature, and alignment artefacts. Enables 3-D structure viewers, comparative modelling, and structure-guided analyses.

epitope.purpose: Captures experimentally verified immune epitopes (primarily imported from IEDB) mapped to BV-BRC proteins, including sequence, host context, coordinate mapping, assay counts, and taxonomy — enabling vaccine-design dashboards and immunogenicity searches.

epitope_assay.purpose: Captures detailed experimental assay records (B-cell, T-cell, MHC binding, etc.) linked to immune epitopes in BV-BRC, including measurement values, host context, MHC alleles, structural mapping, and literature citations — powering immunogenicity dashboards and vaccine design tools.

experiment.purpose: Captures high-level metadata for functional-omics experiments (transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, etc.) imported from GEO, PRIDE, SRA or supplied by users, linking them to biosets, genomes, treatments and publications in BV-BRC.

bioset.purpose: Represents a contrast or set of statistically significant entities (genes, proteins, metabolites, etc.) derived from an experiment — typically a differential-expression list or time-point cluster — linking analysis parameters, groups, thresholds, and downstream result rows.

bioset_results.purpose: Stores per-entity quantitative results (counts, fold-changes, statistics) for each bioset / experiment in BV-BRC’s Functional Genomics section.

fields.name: bioset_id
fields.definition: Stable BV-BRC identifier for the bioset

fields.name: entity_id
fields.definition: BV-BRC ID of the measured entity

fields.name: entity_name
fields.definition: Name or symbol of the entity

fields.name: id
fields.definition: Primary key for the result row

ppi.purpose: Stores pairwise protein–protein (or molecule) interaction metadata culled from curated databases and in-house predictions, including detection methods, confidence scores, supporting literature, domains, and genome context, enabling network visualisation and comparative interactomics within BV-BRC.

sequence_feature.purpose: Captures per-genome sequence features such as SNPs, indels, peptide motifs, or lineage-defining mutations, linking them to standardized feature definitions (sf_id), parent genes, evidence codes, and literature. Drives mutation browsers, lineage calling, and comparative variant analysis inside BV-BRC.

fields.name: aa_sequence_md5
fields.definition: MD5 hash of the AA sequence after variation

sequence_feature_vt.purpose: Tracks each specific variant form of a canonical sequence feature across all BV-BRC genomes, recording its altered sequence, prevalence (genome count/list), and metadata. This fuels variant-frequency dashboards, lineage assignment, and mutation co-occurrence analyses.

fields.name: sfvt_genome_count
fields.definition: Number of genomes with this variant

surveillance.purpose: Records rich case-level epidemiological, clinical and environmental metadata that link one or more BV-BRC genomes to patient or wildlife surveillance information. Enables geospatial outbreak dashboards, risk-factor analyses, and integration with public-health reporting.

fields.name: days_elapsed_to_disease_status
fields.definition: Days from exposure to symptom onset

fields.name: days_elapsed_to_sample_collection
fields.definition: Days from symptom onset to sampling

fields.name: submission_date
fields.definition: Date row was submitted to BV-BRC

serology.purpose: Holds detailed laboratory serology results linked to host metadata and, when available, matching viral genomes—enabling BV-BRC users to study antibody prevalence, vaccine impact, and cross-reactivity in both humans and animals.

structured_assertion.purpose: Stores machine-readable statements about genomic features (e.g., “this gene confers resistance to ciprofloxacin”) together with evidence codes, literature links, scores and access control. These assertions feed AMR dashboards, virulence searches, and downstream analytics in BV-BRC.

enzyme_class_ref.purpose: Provides the authoritative mapping between EC numbers, their official textual descriptions, and corresponding Gene Ontology molecular-function terms, enabling BV-BRC to link genomic features to enzyme activities, metabolic pathways, and GO-based enrichment tools.

gene_ontology_ref.purpose: Provides the authoritative mapping between GO identifiers, their names, textual definitions, and ontology namespaces, enabling BV-BRC to annotate genome features, perform GO enrichment analyses, and supply accurate tool-tips in user interfaces.

id_ref.purpose: Serves as a central “cross-walk” table that links BV-BRC features to a variety of external identifier systems (NCBI GeneID, Ensembl, Pfam, etc.), facilitating cross-database annotation, search, and data export.

protein_family_ref.purpose: Provides the authoritative lookup table for every PATRIC protein-family accession, recording its descriptive name and the namespace (global PGFam vs. local PLFam). This enables BV-BRC to map genome features to families, power pan-genome tools, and generate family-based annotations.

misc_niaid_sgc.purpose: Tracks gene/protein targets selected by the NIAID Structural Genomics Centers (SGC) for clone production, expression trials and structure determination. Provides BV-BRC users with quick insight into clone/protein availability and project status for potential reagent requests or drug-target prioritisation.

fields.name: gene_symbol_collection
fields.definition: Gene symbols associated with the target

spike_variant.purpose: Tracks month-by-month global and regional statistics for notable SARS-CoV-2 spike-protein variants—capturing their defining amino-acid changes, prevalence, growth rates, and lineage diversity—so BV-BRC users can monitor emerging variants of concern.

fields.name: aa_variant
fields.definition: Amino-acid change(s) that define the spike variant

fields.name: country
fields.definition: Country with highest prevalence during the reporting month

fields.name: lineage_count
fields.definition: Number of distinct Pango lineages carrying this variant in the given month

fields.name: prevalence
fields.definition: Percentage of worldwide isolates in month that carry aa_variant

fields.name: total_isolates
fields.definition: Total number of genomes analysed for the month

spike_lineage.purpose: Tracks month-by-month global and regional statistics for SARS-CoV-2 Pango lineages, including growth rates, prevalence, VOC status and defining spike-mutation sets — enabling BV-BRC users to monitor emerging or declining lineages of concern.

fields.name: country
fields.definition: Country with highest prevalence for this lineage in the reporting month

fields.name: lineage_count
fields.definition: Number of sub-lineages collapsed into this record for month

fields.name: prevalence
fields.definition: Percentage of worldwide isolates in month that belong to this lineage

fields.name: total_isolates
fields.definition: Total genomes analysed for the month
